"""RFC 7807-style reporting for migrated Meridian CRM validation failures."""

_VALID_CODES = frozenset(
    {
        "E1001",
        "E1002",
        "E1003",
        "E1004",
        "E1005",
        "E2001",
        "E2002",
        "E2003",
        "E2004",
        "E3001",
        "E3002",
        "E3003",
        "E3004",
        "E3005",
        "E3006",
        "E3007",
        "E4001",
        "E4002",
        "E4003",
        "E4004",
        "E5001",
        "E5002",
        "E5003",
        "E5004",
        "E5005",
    }
)

_PROBLEM_TYPE = "https://meridian-crm.example/problems/validation"
_PROBLEM_TITLE = "Legacy validation failed"


def problem_details(errors: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Build a validation problem document from collected legacy failures."""
    for error in errors:
        if error["code"] not in _VALID_CODES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown legacy validation code: {error['code']!r}")

    blocked = any(error["severity"] == "BLOCK" for error in errors)

    return {
        "type": _PROBLEM_TYPE,
        "title": _PROBLEM_TITLE,
        "status": 422 if blocked else 200,
        "blocked": blocked,
        "errors": [
            {
                "code": error["code"],
                "message": error["message"],
                "severity": error["severity"],
            }
            for error in errors
        ],
    }
